description: Dataset Floods South Sudan is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. This dataset contains the static and dynamic covariates used to train a flood detection model for South Sudan. Static covariates include terrain-derived variables (Digital Elevation Model, slope, curvature, HAND, and Topographic Wetness Index), while dynamic covariates consist of Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical imagery temporally aligned with flood events reported by UNOSAT/OCHA HDX. Coverage: South Sudan. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
